description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Suscon Property Developers (Pvt) Ltd. Exempt from the requirement of Obtaining a license for distributing Electricity
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka issuing a Certificate of Exemption from licensing requirements under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended). This constitutes a regulatory action and falls under legal/regulatory matters, specifically dealing with statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements in the electricity sector.
